item.title: Gocchiru -Lovely Lady Maker-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Tomato
  • 発売日: 2007-09-28
  • スコア: 6.74/10 (13 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ごっちる-ラブリーレディーメーカー-
  • 英語名: Gocchiru -Lovely Lady Maker-

あらすじ

The main character used to be the boss of the soldiers. But, he lost his wife several years ago, and he’s been depressed since then. One day, the god tells him to bring up a daughter of the god for two years. He reluctantly accepts it, and names her Cecile. If she doesn’t grow up to be a “fine” girl, she’ll be returned to the heaven. He works hard everyday, and one year passes. As a trial, the god grows her up, and she becomes an adult. She works hard for him as well, and they live a peaceful life together. But, she gradually falls in love with him, and tells him that she loves him. He also loves her, and they finally sleep together…. Will she be able to be a “fine” girl in the end…?

item.title: Mugen Tenshi Exusia
item.description:

  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 夢幻天使エクスシア
  • 英語名: Mugen Tenshi Exusia

别名

  • Mugen Angel Exusia

あらすじ

Tatsuya is told by Ouka that she loves him. However, he loves Yuki, so he refuses it. One night, a huge mark appears on the sky and it never disappears. No one knows what it is. In this confusion, Tatsuya happens to know his and Yuki’s identity. Tatsuya is a son of the God and Yuki is an angel, his supervisor. The mark on the sky is a warning sign that someone breaks into the heaven. Tatsuya and Yuki start working together to check it and they find out that they love each other along the way and finally sleep together…. And they find out the ringleader is the Devil at last…. Will they be able to destroy the ringleader and save the world?

item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Tomato
  • 発売日: 2003-09-26
  • スコア: なし (4 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ふたりじめ～幼なじみと夏と義妹～
  • 英語名: Futarijime Osananajimi to Natsu to Imouto

あらすじ

Last summer the hero of this game went on vacation and got to know a beautiful classmate of his better. Whether or not the attraction was mutual, he confessed his love to her within the short time they spent together. Now the hero is in his senior year of high school when his parent (don’t know which one) remarries and lo and behold: his new step-sister is the same girl he confessed to just a year ago–awkward. Now summer vacation has come again and our hero is considering his feelings not just for this girl, but her sister as well–despite the taboo.

item.title: Himezanmai ~Ochiyuku Sanshimai~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Tomato
  • 発売日: 2002-03-29
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 姫三妹～堕ち行く三姉妹～
  • 英語名: Himezanmai Ochiyuku Sanshimai

别名

  • 姫三妹～堕ちゆく三姉妹～

あらすじ

The protagonist, Iijima Naoto (changeable), became an orphan after his father died and his older sister went missing. He was then adopted by Sakurai Yuuzou, a prominent businessman and politician, and came to live with Yuuzou’s three daughters. But one day, he found a photograph in Yuuzou’s study, and then he realized that he had been deceived all this time. The photo showed his older sister being raped by Yuuzou, leaving her in a miserable state. His father, who had been hospitalized in a mental hospital, had told him about Yuuzou’s cruelty, but he didn’t believe it because he thought it was just a delusion of his mentally ill father. But now the photo and his father’s words are linked, Naoto decided to take “revenge” on Yuuzou…
